description: Connect a domain the user ALREADY OWNS to a live Kleap app (routing + automatic TLS). The app must be live first — a create_app/modify_app with deployment_status deployed already counts as published, so you do NOT need publish_app first. The user points the domain's A record to Kleap. Does not buy anything.

context.description: Why this call, in one short sentence. Used to improve the connector; never include credentials or personal data.

name: connect_domain
title: Connect Domain
